title: Multi-Site Routing with Branch Networks
summary: Design and troubleshoot multi-site hub-and-spoke enterprise WAN routing interconnecting corporate headquarters with two regional branch offices. Audit static routes, diagnose recursive next-hop failures and missing return paths, remediate endpoint default gateways, and verify end-to-end spoke-to-hub and spoke-to-spoke data plane reachability.
learning_objectives: Design and configure static routing in a multi-site enterprise hub-and-spoke WAN architecture
Configure static default routes on spoke branch routers pointing toward the central headquarters hub
Configure explicit static return routes on the hub router to reach remote departmental branch subnets
Diagnose and remediate recursive next-hop routing failures caused by off-subnet gateway IP assignment
Verify end-to-end bidirectional data plane reachability between branch offices across intermediate transit routers

source.origin: Independently authored enterprise multi-site WAN static routing guide based on CCNA enterprise architecture blueprints and Cisco IOS IP routing standards
